title: Customer-Supplied Parts and Special-Order Parts Terms by Tier — Service Accounts and Repair Orders
content:
**Parts counter terms of Service Accounts and Repair Orders.**

| Tier | Store installs parts the customer supplies | Special-order deposit (share of the part's price) | Restocking charge on a cancelled special order (share of the part's price) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Service Guest Account | No | 50% | 20% |
| Kessler Owner Rewards Silver | No | 50% | 20% |
| Kessler Owner Rewards Gold | No | 50% | 15% |
| Kessler Owner Rewards Platinum | No | 25% | 10% |
| Commercial Fleet Account - Net 15 | Yes | 0% | 10% |
| Commercial Fleet Account - Net 30 | Yes | 0% | 10% |

A 0% deposit means no deposit is collected when the part is ordered.

**Hypothetical.** A special-order part priced at 380.00 on an account at Kessler Owner Rewards Platinum takes a deposit of 25%, 95.00; if the customer cancels it after it is ordered, the restocking charge at 10% is 38.00.
